title: Atividade
description: Passos, tempo ativo, calorias, distância e andares, com a meta diária, pela hora local de cada registro.

targets.rawSql:
with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local,
         now() at time zone '$__timezone' as now_local
),
first_data as (
  select read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', min(window_start)) as bucket from read_model.current_hourly_steps
),
buckets as (
  select generate_series(
           greatest(read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', from_local), first_data.bucket),
           read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', least(to_local, now_local)),
           '1 $agrupar'::interval) as bucket
  from period, first_data
  where first_data.bucket is not null
),
metric as (
  select read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', window_start) as bucket, sum(steps) as value
  from read_model.current_hourly_steps, period
  where window_start >= from_local and window_start < to_local
  group by 1
),
goal as (
  select read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', day::timestamp) as bucket, sum(steps) as goal
  from read_model.current_daily_goal, period
  where goal = 'steps_goal' and '$agrupar' <> 'hour'
    and day >= from_local::date and day < to_local
  group by 1
)
select coalesce(b.bucket, m.bucket, g.bucket) at time zone '$__timezone' as time,
       case when m.bucket is not null then coalesce(m.value, 0) when b.bucket is not null then 0 end as "Passos",
       g.goal as "Meta"
from buckets b
full outer join metric m on m.bucket = b.bucket
full outer join goal g on g.bucket = coalesce(b.bucket, m.bucket)
where coalesce(b.bucket, m.bucket, g.bucket) < (select to_local from period)
  and coalesce(b.bucket, m.bucket, g.bucket) <= (select read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', now_local) from period)
order by 1
